For unintended unlocking or overlapping near/far readings, turn Walk-up unlock off before further investigation. Do not repeat an unintended command just to collect a report. Hardware failure is not an established explanation for the reported XS case.

Enable Test logs before a test and export afterward. Review attachments before posting publicly. Remove account details, phone numbers, VINs, locations, device identifiers and tokens. Never attach Bluetooth keys, Apple-account credentials, certificates, provisioning or pairing files.
